name: birds_captions
description: Bird appearance captions (CUB-200-2011, 10 captions per image joined). Goal: birds of the SAME species collapse to a heavily overlapping KG anchored on shared body parts and their colors. The KG is built ONLY from described appearance (parts, colors, shapes) — NEVER the species name (which is the held-out class label). Same-species images share part/color triples; different species differ in coloration, giving W_kg both within-class sharing and cross-class boundary.
canonicalization_hints: ANCHOR: every caption describes one bird — use a single generic 'Bird' subject node. NEVER emit the species name (Gull, Albatross, etc.) as an entity; it is the held-out label and would leak the class into the KG. Describe only what the appearance text states.

REIFY parts: (Bird, has_part, <Part>) then attach the part's attributes to the PART node, e.g. (Beak, has_color, Black), (Beak, has_shape, Curved). This makes 'Beak'/'Black' shared entities across the whole corpus — the only basis of cross-document KG overlap.

Closed BODY_PART vocabulary (canonicalize synonyms): Beak (bill->Beak), Wing, Tail, Crown, Head, Breast, Belly, Throat, Nape, Back, Eye (eye ring->Eye), Eye_Ring, Leg (tarsus/feet/legs->Leg), Wingbar, Retrices (outer retrices->Retrices). Map any synonym to the canonical part; drop parts not in this list unless clearly central.

Closed COLOR palette (canonicalize shades): Black, White, Grey (gray->Grey), Brown, Buff, Yellow, Orange, Red, Pink, Blue, Green, Tan (light brown->Tan). Map 'dark'->prefix dropped (just the hue); if only 'dark'/'light' with no hue, skip the color.
Closed SHAPE vocabulary: Curved, Straight, Hooked, Pointed, Rounded, Long, Short, Webbed. Closed SIZE: Small, Medium, Large. Closed PATTERN: Spotted, Streaked, Striped, Solid, Mottled.
Body-level color is fine as (Bird, has_color, White) when the caption says 'an all white bird'. Size as (Bird, has_size, Medium).
The 10 joined captions repeat the same facts in different words — EXTRACT EACH FACT ONCE (the critique pass dedups). Keep only attributes actually stated; do not infer unstated colors/parts.

inline_examples.text: a bird has a rounded crown that is white, a bright yellow bill, and dark black spotted outer retrices. this bird is white and grey in color with a curved orange and white beak and white eye ring.

an all white bird with darker colored legs and small eyes. this medium sized bird is completely white with black legs and a grey bill. a white bird with a straight gray bill, and black tarsus and feet.
